# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

tissues <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

MIRNA_PAIRS_CSV <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs/output/02_integration/2026-04-27/union/negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv"

# Significance threshold for pathway enrichment (cluster-level)
PADJ_THRESHOLD <- 0.05

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.5_mirna_module_mapping", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output:", dir_output, "\n")

tissue_pal <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(length(tissues)),
  tissues
)

# miRNA cluster colors — identical to 03_miRNA_mRNA_circus_20260421.Rmd
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD",
  "2" = "#FDCDAC",
  "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4",
  "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)
```

# 3. Load miRNA–cluster mapping from cosine pairs

Each miRNA belongs to one cluster per tissue.

```{r load_mirna_clusters}
if (!file.exists(MIRNA_PAIRS_CSV))
  stop("miRNA pairs file not found: ", MIRNA_PAIRS_CSV)

cosine_pairs <- read.csv(MIRNA_PAIRS_CSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster))

# Unique (tissue, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_Name) — one miRNA per cluster per tissue
mirna_cluster_map <- cosine_pairs %>%
  distinct(tissue, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_Name) %>%
  arrange(tissue, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_Name)

cat("miRNA-cluster entries:", nrow(mirna_cluster_map), "\n")
mirna_cluster_map %>%
  count(tissue, miRNA_cluster, name = "n_miRNAs") %>%
  arrange(tissue, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# 4. Load pathway enrichment per cluster from 04_GO_KEGG

```{r load_pathways}
find_latest_dated_dir <- function(base) {
  dirs  <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated <- sort(dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(dirs))],
                decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(dated) == 0) stop("No dated subdirectory under: ", base)
  cat("Using:", dated[1], "\n")
  dated[1]
}

safe_read <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) { cat("Not found — skipped:", basename(path), "\n"); return(NULL) }
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% as_tibble()
  cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows:", basename(path), "\n")
  df
}

dir_04   <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04_GO_KEGG"))

go_bp    <- safe_read(file.path(dir_04, "GO",      "GO_BP_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
kegg     <- safe_read(file.path(dir_04, "KEGG",    "KEGG_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
msigdb   <- safe_read(file.path(dir_04, "MSigDB",  "MSigDB_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
reactome <- safe_read(file.path(dir_04, "Reactome","Reactome_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
```

```{r combine_pathways}
# Standardise to: tissue, miRNA_cluster, source, pathway_id, Description, p.adjust
add_source <- function(df, src) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    mutate(miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster),
           source        = src) %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, miRNA_cluster, source,
                  pathway_id = ID, Description, p.adjust)
}

msigdb_rows <- if (!is.null(msigdb) && nrow(msigdb) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(unique(msigdb$msigdb_set), function(s) {
    add_source(
      msigdb %>% filter(msigdb_set == s),
      paste0("MSigDB:", s)
    )
  }))
} else NULL

cluster_pathways <- bind_rows(
  add_source(go_bp,    "GO BP"),
  add_source(kegg,     "KEGG"),
  add_source(reactome, "Reactome"),
  msigdb_rows
) %>%
  filter(p.adjust <= PADJ_THRESHOLD)

cat("\nSignificant pathway-cluster entries (p.adjust <=", PADJ_THRESHOLD, "):",
    nrow(cluster_pathways), "\n")
cat("Sources:", paste(sort(unique(cluster_pathways$source)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Tissues:", paste(sort(unique(cluster_pathways$tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 5. Load module membership from 04.3

```{r load_modules}
dir_04_3    <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.3_pathway_network"))
modules_csv <- file.path(dir_04_3, "pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv")

if (!file.exists(modules_csv))
  stop("pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv not found — run 04.3 first.")

# node_id format: "source_db|pathway_id"  e.g. "GO BP|GO:0042552"
module_membership <- read.csv(modules_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    module     = as.character(module),
    source_db  = sub("\\|.*$",    "", node_id),
    pathway_id = sub("^[^|]+\\|", "", node_id),
    module_id  = paste0(tissue, "_mod", module)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, source_db, pathway_id, module, module_id, Description)

cat("Module membership entries:", nrow(module_membership), "\n")
cat("Tissues:", paste(sort(unique(module_membership$tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 6. Join: cluster-enriched pathways → module

```{r join_cluster_module}
# Join on tissue + source + pathway_id
cluster_module <- cluster_pathways %>%
  inner_join(
    module_membership %>%
      dplyr::select(tissue, source = source_db, pathway_id, module, module_id),
    by = c("tissue", "source", "pathway_id")
  )

cat("Pathway-cluster entries with module assignment:",
    nrow(cluster_module), "\n")

# Aggregate: per (tissue, miRNA_cluster, module) — count shared pathways
cluster_module_agg <- cluster_module %>%
  group_by(tissue, miRNA_cluster, module, module_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pathways     = n_distinct(pathway_id),
    top_pathways   = paste(head(Description, 3), collapse = "; "),
    min_p_adj      = min(p.adjust),
    .groups        = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module, miRNA_cluster)

cat("Cluster-module pairs:", nrow(cluster_module_agg), "\n\n")
cluster_module_agg %>% print(n = 30)
```

# 7. Map miRNAs to modules

Join cluster-module aggregation with individual miRNA names.

```{r mirna_module_table}
mirna_module_tbl <- cluster_module_agg %>%
  inner_join(mirna_cluster_map, by = c("tissue", "miRNA_cluster")) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_Name)

cat("miRNA-module entries:", nrow(mirna_module_tbl), "\n\n")

# Summary: per (tissue, module) → distinct miRNAs
module_mirna_summary <- mirna_module_tbl %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clusters    = n_distinct(miRNA_cluster),
    n_miRNAs      = n_distinct(miRNA_Name),
    miRNA_list    = paste(sort(unique(miRNA_Name)), collapse = ", "),
    cluster_list  = paste(sort(unique(miRNA_cluster)), collapse = ", "),
    n_pathways_total = sum(n_pathways),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue, as.integer(module))

cat("=== Module–miRNA summary ===\n")
module_mirna_summary %>% print(n = Inf)

write.csv(mirna_module_tbl,
          file.path(dir_output, "mirna_module_full.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(module_mirna_summary,
          file.path(dir_output, "module_mirna_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: mirna_module_full.csv, module_mirna_summary.csv\n")
```

# 8. Pathway detail: top pathways linking each cluster to its module

```{r pathway_detail}
pathway_detail <- cluster_module %>%
  inner_join(
    mirna_cluster_map %>%
      group_by(tissue, miRNA_cluster) %>%
      summarise(miRNA_list = paste(sort(unique(miRNA_Name)), collapse = ", "),
                .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("tissue", "miRNA_cluster")
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module, miRNA_cluster, p.adjust) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module_id, miRNA_cluster, miRNA_list,
                source, pathway_id, Description, p.adjust)

cat("=== Top 3 linking pathways per (tissue, module, cluster) ===\n")
pathway_detail %>%
  group_by(tissue, module_id, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

write.csv(pathway_detail,
          file.path(dir_output, "pathway_detail.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: pathway_detail.csv\n")
```

# 9. Visualization

## 9a. Combined heatmap: miRNA cluster (rows) × module (columns, split by tissue)

```{r heatmap_combined, fig.height=5, fig.width=16}
# Column order: modules sorted by tissue order then module number
mod_col_order <- cluster_module_agg %>%
  distinct(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = tissues)) %>%
  arrange(tissue, as.integer(module)) %>%
  pull(module_id)

# Row order: cluster numbers in fixed order
clu_row_order <- as.character(sort(as.integer(names(cluster_colors))))

# Build complete matrix (all cluster × module combinations, fill 0)
mat_all <- cluster_module_agg %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_cluster, module_id, n_pathways) %>%
  tidyr::complete(miRNA_cluster = clu_row_order,
                  module_id     = mod_col_order,
                  fill          = list(n_pathways = 0L)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = module_id, values_from = n_pathways, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  column_to_rownames("miRNA_cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat_all <- mat_all[clu_row_order, mod_col_order, drop = FALSE]

# Column split by tissue
col_split <- factor(sub("_mod.*$", "", colnames(mat_all)), levels = tissues)

# Row annotation: cluster color bar on the left
row_cols <- cluster_colors[rownames(mat_all)]
row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  cluster = anno_simple(
    rownames(mat_all),
    col   = row_cols,
    width = unit(5, "mm")
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  show_legend          = FALSE
)

# log1p transform for color mapping: spreads sparse non-zero values apart
# Colors mirror the white→red positive half of 04.4 target score heatmap
# Fixed upper limit at 100 so the color scale is comparable across runs
mat_log <- log1p(mat_all)
max_log <- log1p(100)
col_fn  <- colorRamp2(c(0, max_log / 2, max_log),
                      c("#F0F0F0", "#FC8D59", "#D73027"))

ht_all <- Heatmap(
  mat_log,
  name              = "n pathways\n(log1p)",
  col               = col_fn,
  na_col            = "grey90",
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  column_split      = col_split,
  column_gap        = unit(4, "mm"),
  border_gp         = gpar(col = "grey30", lwd = 1.2),
  rect_gp           = gpar(col = "white",  lwd = 0.4),
  left_annotation   = row_anno,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    v <- mat_all[i, j]   # show original integer count
    if (v > 0)
      grid.text(v, x, y,
                gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,
                           col = ifelse(mat_log[i, j] > max_log * 0.6,
                                        "white", "grey20")))
  },
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot  = 45,
  column_title_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title         = NULL,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                               at     = log1p(c(0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100)),
                               labels = c("0", "1", "5", "10", "25", "50", "100"))
)

lgd_cluster <- Legend(
  labels    = names(row_cols),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = row_cols),
  title     = "miRNA cluster",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(ht_all, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster))

n_cols <- ncol(mat_all)
png(file.path(dir_output, "heatmap_all_tissues.png"),
    width  = max(1600, n_cols * 60 + 400),
    height = 700, res = 150)
draw(ht_all, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster))
dev.off()

svg(file.path(dir_output, "heatmap_all_tissues.svg"),
    width  = max(12, n_cols * 0.4 + 4),
    height = 5)
draw(ht_all, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster))
dev.off()

cat("Saved: heatmap_all_tissues.png / .svg\n")
```

## 9b. Per-tissue bubble chart: module × miRNA (individual level)

```{r bubble_per_tissue, results="asis", fig.height=7, fig.width=11}
for (tis in tissues) {
  df_tis <- mirna_module_tbl %>% filter(tissue == tis)
  if (nrow(df_tis) == 0) {
    cat("\n\n###", tis, "\n\nNo data.\n\n"); next
  }
  cat("\n\n###", tis, "\n\n")

  mod_lvls <- paste0(tis, "_mod",
                     sort(as.integer(unique(df_tis$module))))

  # Row order: cluster ascending, then alphabetically within cluster
  mir_lvls <- df_tis %>%
    distinct(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
    mutate(miRNA_cluster = as.integer(miRNA_cluster)) %>%
    arrange(miRNA_cluster, miRNA_Name) %>%
    pull(miRNA_Name)

  df_plot <- df_tis %>%
    mutate(module_id     = factor(module_id, levels = mod_lvls),
           miRNA_cluster = factor(miRNA_cluster, levels = names(cluster_colors)),
           label         = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
           label         = factor(label, levels = rev(sub("^mmu-", "", mir_lvls))))

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = module_id, y = label)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n_pathways, fill = miRNA_cluster),
               shape = 21, color = "grey30", alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "n shared\npathways") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE,
                      name = "miRNA\ncluster") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(tis, " — miRNA × module"),
      subtitle = paste0(n_distinct(df_plot$label), " miRNAs  ×  ",
                        n_distinct(df_plot$module_id), " modules"),
      x = "Module", y = "miRNA"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92")
    )

  print(p)

  w <- max(5, n_distinct(df_plot$module_id)  * 0.9 + 3)
  h <- max(4, n_distinct(df_plot$miRNA_Name) * 0.28 + 2)
  ggsave(file.path(dir_output, paste0("bubble_", tis, ".png")),
         p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
  ggsave(file.path(dir_output, paste0("bubble_", tis, ".svg")),
         p, width = w, height = h)
  cat("Saved: bubble_", tis, ".png / .svg\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## 9c. Combined bubble chart: miRNA (rows) × all tissues (columns, left → right)

```{r bubble_combined}
tissue_order_combined <- c("hypo", "liver", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

df_comb <- mirna_module_tbl %>%
  filter(tissue %in% tissue_order_combined) %>%
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order_combined))

# Module factor levels: ordered by tissue_order_combined, then module number within tissue
module_lvls_comb <- df_comb %>%
  distinct(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  mutate(module_int = as.integer(module)) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module_int) %>%
  pull(module_id)

# Global miRNA row order: lowest cluster number across tissues, then alphabetically
mir_order_comb <- df_comb %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name) %>%
  slice_min(as.integer(miRNA_cluster), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(as.integer(miRNA_cluster), miRNA_Name) %>%
  pull(miRNA_Name)

# Short label (strip "mmu-" prefix); factor levels reversed so top of plot = cluster 1
label_comb <- sub("^mmu-", "", mir_order_comb)

df_comb <- df_comb %>%
  mutate(
    module_id     = factor(module_id, levels = module_lvls_comb),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(miRNA_cluster, levels = names(cluster_colors)),
    label         = factor(sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
                           levels = rev(label_comb))
  )

n_mir_comb <- n_distinct(df_comb$miRNA_Name)
n_mod_comb <- n_distinct(df_comb$module_id)

# Base plot (no theme — shared between screen and print)
p_bubble_base <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = module_id, y = label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_pathways, fill = miRNA_cluster),
             shape = 21, color = "grey30", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 20), name = "n shared\npathways") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE,
                    name = "miRNA\ncluster") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^[^_]+_mod", "", x)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title    = "Combined miRNA × module bubble plot",
    subtitle = paste("Tissues:", paste(tissue_order_combined, collapse = " | ")),
    x        = "Module",
    y        = "miRNA"
  )

# Screen theme: 12pt, 0.28 inch/row
theme_screen <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

# Print theme: 42pt (= 8pt × 945/180), 0.14 inch/row × scale_factor
scale_factor <- 945 / 180
theme_print <- theme_bw(base_size = 42) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 42),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 42),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 42)
  )

# HTML display
print(p_bubble_base + theme_screen)

# Save with print theme
p_bubble_print <- p_bubble_base + theme_print
w_comb  <- max(16, n_mod_comb * 0.7 + 5)
h_screen <- max(5, n_mir_comb * 0.28 + 2.5)
h_print  <- max(5, n_mir_comb * 0.14 + 2.5) * scale_factor

ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "bubble_combined.png"),
       p_bubble_print, width = w_comb, height = h_print, dpi = 150,
       limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "bubble_combined.svg"),
       p_bubble_print, width = w_comb, height = h_print,
       limitsize = FALSE)
cat("Saved: bubble_combined.png / .svg\n")
```

## 9d. Summary barplot: miRNAs per module across all tissues

```{r summary_barplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=13}
bar_df <- module_mirna_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(module_id)) %>%
  mutate(module_id = factor(module_id,
                            levels = module_id[order(tissue, as.integer(module))]))

p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = n_miRNAs, y = module_id, fill = tissue)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_miRNAs), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tissue_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Number of miRNAs linked to module",
       y = NULL,
       title = "miRNAs per tissue-module (via cluster pathway enrichment)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")

print(p_bar)

ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "summary_mirnas_per_module.png"),
       p_bar, width = 13, height = 8, dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "summary_mirnas_per_module.svg"),
       p_bar, width = 13, height = 8)
cat("Saved: summary_mirnas_per_module.png / .svg\n")
```
